narrative.headline: Top 50 tape is decisively risk-on with 31 of 50 names tilted bullish, led by financials, mega-cap tech, and staples accumulation.
bullish_setups: MS: perfect 10.0 flow score + $153M dark pool — institutions loading the broker
CSCO: $9.7M call premium with 8.82 dark pool conviction and $155M block tape
ORCL: $26.8M near-money call premium + $116M dark pool — AI infra bid continues
INTC: $29M call premium + $94M dark pool — contrarian semis accumulation
AAPL: $47M call premium paired with $133M dark pool, broad-based conviction
GOOG: dark pool prints at 10.0 ($280M) and blocks 9.82 — heaviest institutional footprint on the board
AMD: $38M call premium + $98M dark pool confirms semis dispersion bid
WMT/COST/JNJ: clean 10.0 flow in defensives suggests barbell positioning alongside tech
bearish_setups: CVX: 0.0 flow score — put premium dominant despite XOM going the other way
GEV: 0.56 flow with heavy $8.68 dark pool conviction amplifying the bearish tilt
BAC: 0.80 flow diverges sharply from bullish MS/WFC/C — banks not uniformly bid
V: 1.98 flow with 9.04 dark pool conviction — large players distributing payments
TXN: 1.90 flow + 8.45 dark pool — bearish conviction in analog semis
GE: 1.67 flow weakness despite industrial strength elsewhere
narrative.rotation_signal: Smart money is rotating INTO financials (MS, WFC, C), mega-cap tech/AI infra (GOOG, ORCL, CSCO, AAPL, AMD, INTC), and defensive staples (WMT, COST, JNJ) while rotating OUT of payments (V), select industrials (GE, CAT, GEV), Chevron, TSLA, and LLY. The defensive + tech barbell with banks bid suggests positioning for soft-landing continuation, not a defensive crouch.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Semis split internally — INTC/AMD bullish but TXN bearish, suggesting name-specific rather than sector-wide conviction. Energy bifurcated with XOM bullish (8.41) vs CVX bearish (0.91). Banks mostly bullish but BAC lagging hard against MS/WFC/C strength.
